briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate frontier race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced models this month. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent risks. Prompt injection continues as the dominant production vulnerability.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced reasoning while Anthropic launched Claude 4.5 claiming superior safety benchmarks. Google DeepMind and xAI pushed new multimodal updates; DeepSeek open-sourced its R2 model.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement actions target agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra ramp while Microsoft and Google expand data center footprints in Texas and Arizona. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q3.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve autonomous scientific discovery before 2028 safety standards are finalized?
